image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a vintage audio cassette tape. The cassette has a black plastic housing with a white paper label inserted in the window. The label contains handwritten-style text that appears garbled or AI-generated. The two tape spools are visible through the circular windows, showing dark magnetic tape. Below the cassette, there is a blurry, textured surface that looks like a stack of similar items or a reflective surface with vertical striations.
